parameters.name: ReferenceIds
parameters.description: The list of custom IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). You can specify a maximum of 20 IDs.

parameters.name: VideoIds
parameters.description:
The list of audio or video IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). You can specify a maximum of 20 IDs. You can obtain the audio or video ID by using the following methods:
- If the video is uploaded by using the ApsaraVideo VOD console, log on to the [ApsaraVideo VOD console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose **Media Files** > **Audio/Video** to view the audio or video ID.
- Obtain the audio or video ID from the value of the VideoId response parameter when you call the [CreateUploadVideo](~~55407~~) operation to obtain the upload URL and credential.
- After the audio or video file is uploaded, you can call the [SearchMedia](~~86044~~) operation to query the audio or video ID, which is the value of the VideoId response parameter.
